step_1: per model and horizon, mean full-horizon normalized (z-space) validation MSE over seeds 42/43/44
step_2: normalize each model's mean MSE at that horizon by the frozen reference baseline `last_value_naive` on the same horizon
step_3: Screening score = equal-weight mean of the two normalized horizon scores
normalized_horizon_score_formula: r_h = mean_seed_MSE(model, h) / mean_MSE(reference, h); lower is better
step_4: rank within Group A and Group B separately, ascending S
step_5: retain at least the top two from each group for Full Validation
tie_breakers: lower mean full-horizon validation MAE (z-space), averaged over horizons and seeds
better step-0 ILITOTAL z-space MSE, averaged over horizons and seeds
better literature peak criterion performance (higher mean peak_hit_ratio, then more PTE<=1w & PIE<=25% passes)
tie_remaining_action: advance both, or stop for a budget amendment; never use Test evidence
amendment_policy: the rule is immutable after aggregated results are first read; any change requires a documented budget amendment and invalidates the Screening outcome
